purpose.summary: This is the main access/login program for a web-based COBOL CGI application. It handles user authentication (login/senha), generates HTML pages via an htmlpp preprocessor, logs access events (IP address, date/time) to a CSV log file, and delegates to a MENUS subprogram after successful login.

verdict.notes: The file uses the htmlpp preprocessor (a Micro Focus or GnuCOBOL extension) to embed HTML directly in COBOL source, making this a CGI web application. The $set directives and CBL_ runtime calls strongly indicate Micro Focus COBOL or GnuCOBOL. The COPY statements reference local files not shown. The program appears to be part of a larger multi-program system (MENUS subprogram, various copybooks).
